$comment: Philippine non-working days used for deadline shifting. 2026: per Proclamation No. 1006 (verified Aug 4, 2026, incl. the separately proclaimed Eid dates). 2027: statutory/computable holidays only — the 2027 proclamation is normally issued late 2026; movable and special dates are provisional until then. Special WORKING days (e.g. EDSA anniversary) are excluded — offices are open. Eid'l Fitr / Eid'l Adha 2027 are omitted until proclaimed.

shiftRule.value: A filing/payment deadline falling on a Saturday, Sunday, or non-working holiday moves to the next working day
legalBasis: Consistent BIR administration in annual tax calendars and deadline advisories; see also Civil Code Art 13 computation rules
shiftRule.notes: Applied to BIR deadlines and, as the safe default, to SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG/LGU/SEC dates. The 13th-month-pay deadline is an exception — it must be met on or before Dec 24.

confidenceNote: 2026 dates are verified against Proclamation No. 1006. The 2027 rows are the statutory/computable holidays only — the 2027 proclamation had not issued as of the verification date, and the movable Eid dates are omitted entirely, so deadlines shifting across a 2027 holiday need confirming.

holidays.name: National Heroes Day (last Monday of August)

notes2027.notes: 2027 rows marked provisional (and the 2027 Eid dates, omitted here) must be updated when the 2027 holiday proclamation issues, typically October–November 2026.
